test.title: Career interests (Holland RIASEC)
test.about:
Find out which kinds of work activities you enjoy, using Holland's six interest types (RIASEC): Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising and Conventional. Your top three types form your Holland code, which you can use to explore jobs that fit you.

Based on the O*NET Interest Profiler Short Form (60 work activities).
test.instructions: You will see {n} work activities. For each one, choose how much you would like doing it. Don't think about whether you have the training or how much it pays; just ask yourself whether you would enjoy the work.
test.prompt: Would you like to do this work?
test.chart_subtitle: Your interest in each of Holland's six types (0 to 40).
test.code_about: Your three strongest interest types. People are usually happiest in jobs that match their first one or two letters.
test.flat: Your interests are quite even across types, so the code is less clear-cut. Look at jobs that combine your top types.

R.name: Realistic
R.about: You like practical, hands-on work with tools, machines, plants, animals or the outdoors, where you can see real, physical results.

I.name: Investigative
I.about: You like to observe, learn, analyse and solve problems, especially with ideas, science and data.

A.name: Artistic
A.about: You like to create and express yourself through art, design, writing, music or performance, in settings with freedom and few rules.

S.name: Social
S.about: You like to help, teach, care for and work with people, and to make a difference in their lives.

E.name: Enterprising
E.about: You like to lead, persuade, sell and start projects, take risks and make decisions to reach goals.

C.name: Conventional
C.about: You like structured work with data, records and clear procedures, where accuracy and order matter.
